name: 期間比較の日付別マトリクス
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
ONE compact Japanese date-comparison matrix740x210logical, tightly framed white background with restrained fine neutral grid, no big surrounding card. Heading exact 日付ごとの比較 MeiryoBold20/28 top left. Table header columns: 系列 | 11月16日 | 11月17日 | 11月18日 | 11月19日. First data row: checked square forestgreen with white check, tiny flat forestgreen dot, 今回の利用者 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0. Second data row: checked square forestgreen white check, tiny flatblue#4B78B8dot, 前回の利用者. In each of four previous-period value cells show small gray date above0: 11月15日 then11月16日 then11月17日 then11月18日, each with0 below. These previous dates restore actual source temporal mapping omitted by mock. Keep normal-weight14/24 body,12/16 dates, tiny8pxdots, thin neutral grid, white cells and very light neutral header. No broad mint fill or green grid. Original controls checkbox/glyph/stroke geometry, grouping and preceding date-row semantics; mock supplies Japanese text and explanation zeros. No charts, extra controls, search or invented statistics. All columns/rows visible unclipped.
Evidence-based accent decision: Currentgreen and previousblue preserve period mapping consistently. Checked selection forestgreen with white checks; no whole-table mint wash, header very light neutral. Add previous date subrow from observed source to preserve temporal comparison semantics, mock zeros retained as explanatory data not claimed source values.
reviewNotes: 原画の二期間マトリクスと日本語モックを実見。前回の別日付11月15〜18日を復元し、今回11月16〜19日の列と対応。モック説明値0を維持（原画前回値は透かしで不明）。系列を緑/青で区別、選択チェックを緑、ミント面と緑罫線を中立化。生成画像の文字・日付・全8個の0・2チェック・欠落なしを確認。フォント厳密同定・所有者承認・編集可能性・操作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
